version.value: Tenor with orchestral accompaniment; Italian; source describes acoustic recording
version.note: IA describes an acoustic recording and identifies Victor/Victrola 88061. Attribution to the original C-4317 master is inferred through the catalogue, not confirmed by a legible runout. DAHR lists later electrically re-orchestrated dubs separately as CS-58966; this transfer has not been independently distinguished from every later reissue or dub by matrix inspection. Performing edition unknown.

performers.note: Orchestral accompaniment is documented, but no orchestra name, conductor or individual orchestral players are established by the cited sources.

date.note: Date of the original C-4317 acoustic session, applied through the source’s 1907 attribution and Victor 88061 catalogue identity. The transfer’s exact matrix is not independently confirmed; this is not a date for the physical pressing or transfer.

place.note: Place of the attributed original C-4317 session. No studio address is asserted, and the transfer’s exact matrix has not been independently confirmed.

label.note: The transferred label is identified in the IA metadata; the underlying master is Victor.

catalogue.note: The physical pressing date is unknown; 1907 identifies the original recording and issue history, not this copy’s manufacture.

matrixTakeSides.note: DAHR identifies take 1 as the issued master for Victor 88061; take 2 was held. This identifies the master through the catalogue, not through inspection of a legible runout. IA’s matrix field repeats the catalogue number 88061 and is not accepted as the matrix.

credits.note: IA user_transferred identifies Nicholas Klein; scanningcenter identifies George Blood, L.P.

date.note: The May 2021 upload date is not treated as a documented transfer date.

processing.value: Transferred at 78 rpm using four styli; engineer-preferred version selected
processing.note: The item specifies 3.8, 2.3, 2.8 and 3.3 mil truncated-conical styli. The specific selected stylus and further restoration are not established. Playback audio remains unaltered.

digital.format: Internet Archive VBR MP3 derivative of the supplied 24-bit FLAC disc transfer

composition.value: Historical aria from the 1892 opera Pagliacci
composition.note: The composition is separate from rights in the historic sound recording.

recording.value: US public domain: source identifies recording first published before 1 January 1926
recording.note: Rule 2. IA identifies the historic 1907 Victor/Victrola 88061 issue and describes an acoustic recording; DAHR documents the attributed original 17 March 1907 master. The exact master is inferred through the catalogue, not independently established from a legible runout. Opened IA metadata contains no licenseurl and no non-commercial licence. This does not rely on a modern uploader’s composition-only tag.
